verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native Notion dashboard or chart widgets. What it does show is embedding external dashboards: Tableau charts and dashboards (notion-docs-19) and Mixpanel boards, reports and charts (notion-intdir-2) can be viewed inside Notion pages. Community users report tracking tasks and projects in Notion (notion-comm-11, notion-comm-6), so project data could live there, but reporting on it appears to need extra tools. Missing for 10: native dashboard/widget building, built-in charts or rollups for project progress, and first-party docs or hands-on evidence of progress reporting within Notion itself.
